A dark, unholy union between orcs and vampires, giving rise to a terrifying hybrid race known as the Norcferatu.
The legend follows a tragic perversion of ancient traditions, deeply tied to the lore of Vengoth.The Rise of the NorcferatuHistorically, the orcs of this region possessed a proud, ancestral warrior culture guided by shamanistic traditions.
However, vampiric corruption seeped into their clans. Vampiric leaders, culminating in the father of vampires Vladrukh, warped the orcs' lineage to create orc-dhampir hybrids. This unholy combination fused the raw, physical brutality of orcs with the dark, life-draining blood magic of vampires.The Perverted RitesThe legend is carried heavily by two specific cultist factions of the Norcferatu that players uncover during the quest:The Nightweavers: These were once noble orc shamans and spiritual leaders. They completely abandoned the light to fuse their shamanistic heritage with shadow worship and blood magic, turning their ancestral visions into waking nightmares.The Heartless: In a display of extreme, twisted devotion, these orc-dhampirs literally carve out their own hearts with crude blades. They believe that removing their hearts severs all emotional weakness and fear of death. They preserve their beating hearts in iron-bound "Heart Amphorae" hidden in unholy shrines, fighting as completely unstoppable, emotionless fanatics
The Wrath of the AncestorsThe core tragedy of the story is the absolute defilement of the orcs' heritage. When players commune with the Orcish Ancestor Spirits during the quest, the spirits express deep rage and sorrow. They lament that while their bones rested in the crimson soil, they had to watch their descendants corrupt their own bloodlines and let their noble legacy fade into monstrous servitude.
To aid the player in stopping Vladrukh, the ancestors require a ritual called the Ritual Dance of the Red Moon—a traditional dance meant to awaken the "fire in the blood" and restore a temporary echo of the old, uncorrupted ways to bypass the fortress defenses.Would you like to know more about Vladrukh's specific background as the Father of Vampires, or perhaps the role that Anaztassja Moroia plays in trying to stop them?

quests.g: Loose Ends is a quest for characters who left the Isle of Destiny designed to show them easy quests to gain quick rewards. It is added to your quest log immediately after Captain Kurt sails you off of the Isle, and will disappear once all NPCs have been talked to.
Somebody is illegally cutting trees in the forests north of Carlin and Queen Eloise is not amused.
The Mad Mage summoned more monsters than he could handle.
Great for wise old male mages as well as for pretty enchantresses. If you are looking to earn addons, ladies should take a stroll in Port Hope, whereas elders should explore the Dark Cathedral.

The distant kingdom of Thalassara is a secluded realm recently thrust into the spotlight by the fall of a fragment of the moon. What began as a rush for the newly discovered moonsilver has quickly turned into something far more troubling.

Throughout the quest, you will find yourself dealing with suspicious factions, strange cult activity, and the consequences of forces that should perhaps have remained undisturbed. Expect investigation, infiltration, exploration, puzzles, and a journey that leads from a besieged frontier settlement all the way to places few have ever seen.
The Marlin is a rare fish, perhaps you can find a collector to trade with.
The chief Necromancers of the Brotherhood of Bones hold a valuable treasure here.

There is a book in Mino Hell saying: The mystic portal remains unstable so reinforcements from Mintwallin seldom arrive here. 
The royal mage managed to impress the primitive local orcs though and we can use them as slaves and runefodder. The trolls surrendered immediately and can be used for lesser services.
The human base has to be destroyed since more and more arrive there. These enemies are not strong but their number might cause some problems. As long as they will be revived at this mystic vortex even they can ruin our plans. We have to figure out how to destroy the vortex first. The mage locked himself up in his quarters and wants not to be disturbed anymore. He entrusted me with the duty to coordinate all our actions here.
There's a suspicious raft south of Thais guarded by minotaurs.

quests.l:
- First piece: Nibelor - Inukaya
- Second piece: Zao - Muggy Plains
- Third piece: Kilmaresh - Kha'zeel

quests.g: Deep inside a dragon-filled place a treasure is hidden...
A rockslide revealed another part above the mines.
The adventure begins! Start your journey in the world of Tibia by helping the people of Newhaven, gaining experience, and honing your combat skills as you battle creatures.
Nightmarish creatures are guarding something very appropriate to their nature...

quests.l: Northwest of Carlin, 125.252. The Tibia Observer location is Ice Islands (Carlin)

quests.n: No Rest for the Wicked Quest
quests.g: A magical disturbance has appeared at a remote isle, threatening the balance of the world. Investigate the disturbance and fight powerful Inferniarchs to uncover the truth.

quests.l: Deep in a hidden cave below Mt. Sternum

quests.g: One of our finest pieces. If you have the money and wish to show how wealthy and noble you are, this is the outfit for you. We also create addons especially for you, right here.
Some thieves have stolen something very valuable to the nomads.
Nomads travel through the desert and set up camp in various places.

quests.n: Noodles is Gone Mini World Change
quests.g: The beloved dog of the king is gone, help the king to find him!
Are you feeling cold in this never ending winter of Hrodmir? Perhaps this outfit might fit you.

quests.l:
Ab'Dendriel, Horestis Tomb, Venore, Fiehonja, Gnomebase Alpha, Dwarf Mines,
Otherworld (Dwarf Bridge), Krailos, Replica Dungeon, Gnome Deep Hub and The Cube (Location)
quests.g: Investigate mysterious locations around Tibia and dive into the history of the Planegazers.
The citizens of the recently discovered city of Rathleton require assistance in defending their civilization against various threats.
The Orc King hoards a treasure in his throneroom, guarded by the best warriors of the fortress.

quests.l: Venore Orc Cave, east of Venore
quests.g: An orcish shaman is protecting his treasure in a small orcish outpost near Venore.
The "games" the brutish Orgers partake in serve as thinly veiled excuses to stuff their maws and fill their bellies, while simultaneously harassing the subservient Orcs.
This comfortable, yet fashionable outfit will create the romantic mood of thousand and one nights. A good place to look around for addons are naturally Darama and Ankrahmun.
A trader comes to one of the ports to trade.
The last remaining warrior of the Nightmare Knights was said to have been mortally wounded by dragons to eventually die below the Plains of Havoc.

quests.l: Forests around Ab'Dendriel and near Carlin and the Orc Fortress
quests.g: A fine balance lies between the lives of the White Deer of Ab'Dendriel's forest and the Wolves.
Someone has set up a dangerous trap to protect an important key.

It seems a traveler died when he took the wrong way to some dirty beasts, instead of going trough poison gas and find the treasure guarded by dark magic. - from a once found report. (Katana Quest Cave).

quests.l: various locations in tibia, starts at any city guide

quests.g: Yo ho ho and a bottle of Rum! If you love the pirate way of life and sneer at landlubbers, this might be the right outfit for you. Pirates are said to roam the Shattered Isles...
There is a ghostship that haunts the waters between Venore to Darashia.
The orcish shamans use poisonous equipment for their rituals.

quests.l: Locations of the Feaster of Souls Quest
quests.g: Defeat The Pale Worm to earn the right to be a Poltergeist. Obtain rare ghostly materials to improve your outfit even further.
A Nightmare Knight on his way back to Knightwatch Tower fell down a hole and died to a Giant Spider.
Seymour is searching for a suitable box that he wants to give to the king.

quests.l: Gnomprona, Monster Graveyard, Crystal Enigma and Sparkling Pools
quests.g: The Gnomes have discovered a marvelous new place deep under the surface of the world and need help exploring it.
Honour the Rascoohan folk with special gifts and receive their permission to adorn your typical Rascoohan clothes.
The magistrates of Rathleton would gladly promote you within their ranks if you can fulfil their requirements.

Some of Hector's students were undertaking experiments related to geological studies, exploring the deeper recesses of this world. Rabid wolves mangled the students furthest into the cave, when the others started to run towards the entrance. In the end only Hector made it as he was the slowest of all and not very far into the hole.
Guarded by fire and dark walls, a long forgotten secret lies...
Spectulus and Sinclair need some help with ghost research.

quests.l: All the locations of the Soul War Quest
quests.g: Help Goshnar defeat the manifestation of his evil traits and earn the right to wear the Revenant Outfits.

quests.l: Dungeons of The Ruthless Seven Minions, Adventurer's Guild

quests.g: A powerful ancient weapon meant to be sleeping forever has awoken deep under Vengoth. Portals all over the world lead to fragments of its shattered soul. With thirst for revenge and burning rage she will destroy the world - unless you fight her back.

quests.n: River Runs Deep Mini World Change
quests.g: In the dry zao steppe, suddenly a river is running, containing fish.
Nightmarish creatures are lurking in an island recently found by the Inquisition...

quests.l: Blood Vestibule, Jaded Roots, Putrefactory, Gloom Pillars, Darklight Core
quests.g: Assist the blood god by entering its holy realm of blood and cleansing it from its festering spawn of decay and rot.

quests.n: Rottin Wood and the Married Men Quest
quests.g: The outlaws are in hard times and are looking for someone to help them...

quests.l: Bounac, Bounacean Lion, Forest of Life
quests.g: Prove your worth to Kesar the Younger to become his Royal Advisor.
Sam, the blacksmith of Thais, used to be an avid explorer and he lost his backpack on one of his adventures.

quests.l: Edron and Lost Mines (west of town), Vega
quests.g: None.

quests.l: Begin: Thais, Venore or Carlin. Includes travel through all of Tibia
quests.g: The Secret Services from Carlin, Thais, and Venore want to find out all secrets in Tibia...
The brilliant Yalahari created golems to suit their needs, but this is not as easy a task to do for todays scientists.
If you have seen everything and worn every look, this outfit will put the icing on your cake. Maybe you can earn it by becoming the apprentice of a Shaman... or voodoopriest.
The orcish shamans hoard magical equipment in their hideout.

quests.n: Shards of a Broken Moon Quest
quests.g: Something seems to be off in Marapur lately. Rumour has it that it has something to do with the moon. Perhaps you should talk to Saraki about it.
When Amber sailed to Rookgaard on her raft she forgot her notebook and now she wants it back.
Trolls hide their precious silver necklace from intruders.
An outcast Chakoya is hungry...
Some fierce dragons are guarding their treasure with fire.
They say a group of frost giants tortured a prisoner and stole his money.
A member of the Explorer Society tried to find out more about the Venore Amazon Camp and lost his way.
Billy will reward those who will help him
Plunder a chest containing a pirate captain's savings.

quests.l: Zarganash, Claustrophobic Inferno, Rotten Wasteland, Ebb and Flow, Furious Crater and Mirrored Nightmare
quests.g: Assist Goshnar and destroy his personality shards before they grow stronger and escape to the living world.

quests.l: At the Thaian-Venorean Road, close to Venore
A few steps north east of Triangle Tower
quests.g: A warrior journeyed too far into the earth
Help the Gnomes to fight their enemies around The Spike.

quests.l: Spirit Grounds (via Darama, Ghostlands or Vengoth)
Edron, Ghostlands, Drefia or Mount Sternum Undead Cave or Dark Cathedral, Vengoth Castle or Vandura Mountain or Yalahar Cemetary Quarter, Deeper Banuta or Zao
quests.g: Sinclair needs someone to catch spirits for him using a Spirit Cage for some ghastly research.

Several adventurers reported unusual activities in almost all known dragon lairs. Lots of dragon eggs have been sighted in their caves and it is only a question of time when the next generation of these nasty creatures will be incubated...
Something made a group of Elephants, terrified in the jungle.
An old dwarven explorer has discovered a new steamship route between Thais and Kazordoon.
A minotaur gang's hideout contains stolen items from Kazordoon.
A couple of priestesses are guarding something very valuable to them.
Someone really loves flowers, especially honey flowers...
Great for young mages and ladies who love witchcraft. If you are looking to earn addons, gentlemen should take a stroll in Port Hope, whereas ladies should explore the Dark Cathedral.
The easily treatable swamp fever afflicts only the poorest of Venore, but the cure can be found nearby.

quests.l: Targuna, Aragonia, Crimson Court, Hidden Lizard Temple

quests.g: A guy managed to imprison two cyclopes in the lighthouse basement and forced them to make weapons.
The snow on the glacier north of Svargrond suddenly starts melting.
Seven advisors of the Pharaoh were "entrusted" with the secret to forge part of an ancient powerful mask, and they will fight for an eternity to keep it.
Deep in the earth, near hell, the demons guard their great treasure, who only the bravest could dare to retrieve!
The renowned Merlkin Hairycles is trying to find true friends amongst the humans. To prove that you can be one of those friends, you must help the apes.

quests.l: Ab'Dendriel Carlin Kazordoon Thais Venore Darashia Ankrahmun Edron Port Hope Liberty Bay
quests.g: According to a myth, it is said that a person can extract the essence of an unholy creature using a blessed artifact.

A contest between three wizards has spread across all Tibia so that mysterious letters with coloured powders can now be found everywhere. Choose your wizard and make your friends join your cause - what is your true color?
A scientist with questionable reputation has been conducting abominable experiments on human beings. Will you stop his madness?
Strange things started happening after the pirates of Nargor began mining crystals in a cursed cave...
The Ruthless Seven have sent a powerful demonic being to the Plains Of Havoc. Do you have what it takes to stop it?
An old myth, nearly buried by the sands of time has been discovered by brave adventurers who ventured themselves through the complicated Desert Dungeon, and found its secret.
Ally with the mighty Efreets, a powerful race nearly forgotten by the sands of time, to obtain victory in the everlasting djinn wars against their counterparts, the fearsome Marids.
Ally with the Marids, an ancient race of Djinns to obliterate their counterparts, the fearsome Efreets, and gain eternal trust from those powerful creatures.

quests.l: Edron, Feyrist, Tyrsung, Tiquanda, Outlaw Camp, Darama, Court of Summer, Court of Winter and the Dream Labyrinth
quests.g: The Summer and Winter Courts need help fighting a great threat for the whole world.

quests.l: Begins in Port Hope or Northport, but requires travel throughout Tibia
quests.g: The Explorer Society is a noble order of explorers who have ventured themselves to the very core of the Tibian realm. You can join this society and raise in rank by helping them with their exploration.
The Carlin sewers may be the source of a plague!
Deep under the Sea, a Fire Feathered Serpent sleeps, but its Guardian needs help protecting their realm.

Rumour has it that new clues about the first dragon that had direct contact with humans, Garsharak's son, have come to light. Being the chatterbox he is, Vigintius may know a thing or two about it so make sure to squeeze out any bit of information he has to share.
If you are not afraid to participate in dark ceremonies you should search for Omrabas and offer your help. He has something very handy as reward for your assistance.
Rumour has it plenty of treasure has been hoarded by the dragons in the Kha'zeel Dragon Lairs...

Support Proprietor Piers and join the Great Expedition in Thais. Work together with your friends to keep the wharf safe and the construction running to help get this endeavour on the way. Assemble the perfect crew for the journey and set sail to new horizons!

quests.n: The Hidden City of Beregar Quest
quests.l: Beregar, Fenrock, Mistrock, Ab'dendriel, Yalahar, Venore, Kazordoon
quests.g: There is a tale that concerns a long lost tribe of dwarfs that allegedly settled on one of the islands around Yalahar. Once a brave warrior returned from a journey and vividly described a huge city that he had discovered, inhabited by dwarfs, but nobody believed him.

quests.n: The Hunt for the Sea Serpent Quest
quests.g: There are rumours of Sea Serpents that roam the northern seas and attack ships.

The jarl, Sven the Younger is not too keen in accepting new citizens in the barbarian settlement of Svargrond, and for that reason he will  submit you to a few quests. If succeeded, you will be able to help the other barbarians that are in dire need of help.
The bravest Tibian players are called to free Tibia from all evil Demons.

quests.l: Kazordoon, Yalahar, Liberty Bay, Northport, Isle of Evil, Thais
quests.g: Ancient texts and fairy tales tell of a secret isle of evil...

In that special time of the year when the veil between the worlds is thin and darkness is striving to break through, Lucius calls for Lightbearers to keep sacred light basins burning for four days. Don't let even one go out or all hope is lost.
Help a merchant find out what happened to his brother who followed a beautiful woman into a luxurious palace.
A mage in Zao has created a portal to another dimension, which can only remain open while he is alive.
A pharoah resides in his tomb, but can be awakened again.

quests.l: Farmine, Zao, Kazordoon, Edron, Venore, Thais, Port Hope, Isle of Strife
quests.g: After centuries the resources beneath and around the Big Old One became alarmingly short. Some decades ago, the imperial mining guild financed a project to search and establish new mines far away from Kazordoon.

quests.n: The Order of the Lion Quest
quests.g: Gain the trust of the Order of the Lion and help them fight the usurpers trying to take control of their castle.

quests.n: The Order of the Stag Quest
quests.g: Assist Kesar the Younger.
r: The Broken Sword of Eldoran Etzel

quests.g: The outlaws have secured a very strong sword, and have it protected with traps and puzzles.
Surpass the wrath of a madman and subject yourself to his twisted taunting.

quests.l: Pits of Inferno, under the Plains of Havoc; entrance near the Necromant House
quests.g: The once glorious Nightmare Knights have established themselves under the fiery pits of inferno to fight off evil. The pits of inferno however contain thrones that have a little of the spirit of each of the ruthless seven trapped in there. Absorb their spirit to claim your prize!

quests.l: Begins in Kevin's office at the Tibia Postal Service Headquarters, but takes you all over Tibia
quests.g: It is very hard to become a postman so Kevin has a five step course of Assistant Postman, Postman, Grand Postman, Grand Postman for Special Operations, and Arch Postman.

quests.n: The Queen of the Banshees Quest
quests.l: Isle of the Kings underground and Ghostland
quests.g: You have to complete 7 seals to get to the final room with the rewards. Do not enter the third floor on Isle of Kings or you will have to pay a certain amount of money. Teleporting out means you have to get on the isle using the pearl seal.

Use a special copper key to enter the door to the path that leads you to Hellgate. Once you are there, search for those who atone for the sins of their ancestors. Offer your help and make life easier for them, at least temporarily. If you manage to accomplish all tasks in one day, the repenters might reward you with something special.

quests.n: The Roost of the Graveborn Quest
quests.l: Greenshore, Pits of Inferno, Okolnir, Kha'zeel, Draconia
quests.g: A mysterious Necromancer emerges and puts Tibia’s Dragons in danger.

quests.l: Around Thais - Eclesius' house, Venore, Kazordoon, Ab'Dendriel, Carlin
quests.g: Eclesius is looking for a new assistant

quests.l: Cormaya, Asura Palace, Ancient Ancestorial Grounds, Falcon Bastion, Deep Desert, The Extension Site and the Secret Library
quests.g: Prevent the minions of Variphor from stealing the knowledge about how to use the Godbreaker from the Secret Library of Zathroth.

quests.l: Liberty Bay, Meriana, Goroma, Nargor, Edron
quests.g:
You are pitted in a battle between the peace loving freedom fighters of Meriana and the pillaging foul hordes of Nargor. Your mission is to overcome the pirates of Nargor and help the pirates of Meriana attempt to bring peace to Liberty Bay.

Be careful! There's a storm in the way between Thais and Liberty Bay that may trap the ship and interrupt your trip.

quests.n: The Spirit Will Get You Quest
quests.l: Souleater Mountains in Zao, near the Zao Rebel Camp
quests.g: An old lizard needs help to fulfill the last wishes of her family. Or does she?

quests.l: Tainted Caves in the Green Claw Swamp
quests.g: Release the Tainted Souls roaming the Green Claw Swamp from their plight.

quests.l: Thais, Carlin, Outlaw Camp, Venore, Port Hope, Liberty Bay, Dark Cathedral
quests.g: An underground guild has formed under Thais. Join them by talking to Dorian and learn some of their tricks.

quests.l: Svargrond, Liberty Bay, Port Hope, Ankrahmun, Darashia, Edron and Carlin. Missions also take you to Outlaw Camp, Kazordoon, Ab'Dendriel and the inner parts of Tiquanda
quests.g: Rashid is searching experienced traders, so he can buy their goods. You have to pass a test to prove yourself a worthy trader, one new task each day in a whole week.
The recipe to make the legendary dwarven beer is a well kept secret.

quests.n: The Way of the Monk Quest
quests.l: Blue Valley, Targuna, Thais, Tyrsung, Ab'dendriel, Maze of the Lost Souls, Port Hope, Pits of Inferno, Zao, Corruption Hole, Kilmaresh
quests.g: Follow the path of ancient Merudri to gain wisdom and skills worthy of true monk.

quests.l: Near Carlin, (Ghostlands and the Isle of the Kings)
quests.g: There is an island inhabited by an order of monks, one of those monks has gone missing in the Ghostlands.
A mad mage built a tower in Edron to conduct experiments.

When the bog god arose in Shadowthorn there was conflict between the god's followers and those who would not follow. These others rebelled by starting fires around the town. Once they were contained the town was safe, but only as long as they cannot get free.

quests.l: Fields of Glory, Poacher Caves, Edron, Cormaya, Ulderek's Rock, Venore, Darashia, the Devourer, Feyrist, Candia, and more
quests.g: The nightmares that live in Roshamuul are threatening the peaceful existence of the inhabitants of Feyrist.

Let's celebrate! It's Tibia's birthday! Join us for the party and take part in the festivities! Many exciting activities await you. Try your luck on the piñata dragons. Visit the islands Vigintia and Nostalgia for fun things like can knockdown and a treasure hunt, or take a trip down memory lane.
Someone died on a remote mountain carrying something extremely valuable for besting the harsh conditions there.
The Efreet and Marid and fought for eons, yet maybe the humans can make peace with them.
The elves need your help in a war against nearby villains.
Budrik has been robbed by the The Horned Fox and this time it's personal!

quests.l: Zao, Chazorai, Dragonblaze Peaks, Farmine, Muggy Plains and Zzaion
quests.g: Perhaps you can help an old dwarf in his quest for knowledge and get something out of it yourself as well...

quests.l: Kazordoon, Antrum of the Fallen, Grotto of the Lost, Dwelling of the Forgotten
quests.g: Strange activities have been reported in a crypt under Kazordoon. Can you handle the heat and help the Gnomes' investigation?
A masked man has just stolen Iriana's earnings and she needs your help to retrieve them. The chase may not be as easy as it seems, though.

quests.l: Liberty Bay, Edron, Tiquanda, Nargor and more
quests.g: Arrr! Find the treasure...
Three users of magic plot in a tower filled with undead.

quests.l: Edron Troll Cave, west of town

quests.g: The trolls destroyed the home of the poor Jerom. And now when he planned to open a new store! You can help him to get revenge on the trolls who did this evil to him.

quests.n: Twenty Miles Beneath the Sea Quest
quests.g: Deep under the Sea, a Fire Feathered Serpent sleeps, but its Guardian needs help protecting their realm.

quests.l: Lake Equivocolao in Tiquanda, north of Port Hope
quests.g: Lake Equivocolao is the only known home to the Shimmer Swimmer, but they only appear when the lake is filthy.

quests.l: Mostly Zao Mountain, but takes you all over Tibia
quests.g: Help the cavemen prepare for their hunt.
If you encounter one of the Vampire Lords and slay it, it will drop proof of its death. Storkus might be interested.
A warlock and some heroes guard their treasure in the caves beneath Edron.
Norman The Foreman can always use an extra hand to help out.
The Hive Born threaten the world and must be stopped.

quests.l: Jakundaf Desert, Carlin or Femor Hills
quests.g: A travelling camp of orcs appears on the mainland of tibia.
The lighter version of the knight outfit is great if you want to save stamina and maintain agility. Addons are usually awarded by knight guilds.
A pirate forgot his treasure in a cave in the waterfalls near the traitorous nest of the feared Hydras.

quests.l: In and around Thais, Edron, Cormaya, Kazordoon, Carlin, Venore, Port Hope, Liberty Bay, and several other locations
quests.g: This outfit is ideal for any tibian who loves clowning around or joking other people.
The Percht Queen is awakening. Are you brave enough to resist the perishing cold that originates from her chambers and stop it from creating a neverending winter?
Tarun has noticed the Asuri seem to visit a far away place from time to time. Will you help him investigate it?

quests.l: Lugri (Thais), The Queen Of The Banshees (Ghostlands)
quests.g: Are you feeling evil today? This outfit is fitting for mages pursuing the dark side of sorcery. Shunned by the magic academy of Edron, you might find wizards hiding near Thais.

quests.l: Primarily Zao including the Zao Rebel Camp and Razachai, Banuta
quests.g: Help Zalamon in his fight against the corrupted Emperor.
